dedupe_keys.name: system dynamics model of refuse derived fuel adoption in indonesia s cement industry east java vensim

description: This model explores whether Indonesian cement plants will burn fuel made from municipal rubbish instead of coal, and which policies would speed that up. The producers are Kuntum Khoiro Ummatin, Akhmad Hidayatno, Andri D. Setiawan and Muhammad Afzal Syahrahman Abubakar of Universitas Indonesia, whose article on readiness-contingent policy design was submitted to Clean Technologies and Environmental Policy. It is a system dynamics model in Vensim with six linked modules: population, waste generation, adoption of refuse-derived fuel, fuel production, kiln demand and avoided carbon dioxide. Coverage is East Java province from 2020 to 2045, run under three readiness conditions and four instruments such as landfill tipping fees or a rising target for the share of kiln heat from waste fuel. The deposit contains the model in plain-text and binary form, a baseline run, an outputs workbook with every reported scenario and validation tests, and supplementary tables listing every equation and constant. It is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: needs Vensim to run, the article was not yet published when read, and results depend on assumed prices and yields. Simulation uses: sizing waste processing capacity for fuel production and testing landfill diversion policies. Related records: SWOLFPy (model-swolfpy) models waste system life cycles.
